name: Hiiragi Yumi
source:
A mysterious woman who seems to be involved with the incident that took place a month ago. She is a woman of few words and does not say much, even to [url=https://vndb.org/c93026]Akito[/url] and the others. She's been in contact with [url=https://vndb.org/c93040]Detective Shiraishi[/url]. Presumed to have some kind of ability...?

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_yumi.html]official website[/url]]
